subtitles.en: Let me start with you, Rebecca. What is your confidence that the Fed will be able to stay ahead of inflation? Today's market reaction seems to suggest there's growing optimism. That's the case. Yeah, I think we'd look at how the market responded
subtitles.zh: 先从Rebecca开始。你对美联储能领先通胀有多大信心？今天的市场反应似乎显示乐观情绪升温。确实如此。我认为要看市场对昨天会议的反应

subtitles.en: to yesterday's meeting, all the commentary they're in, as giving some confidence in the Fed's credibility, and it's objective to really tame inflation. We'd also look at what the market
subtitles.zh: 以及所有相关评论，这给了市场一些对美联储可信度的信心，其目标是真正遏制通胀。我们还要看市场

subtitles.en: has already priced in so far this year. Just take the Bloomberg US aggregate for example.
subtitles.zh: 今年已经定价了多少。以彭博美国综合指数为例。

subtitles.en: It's risen the yield about 100 basis points already so far this year, so as we know the bond market tends to do, it prices in a little bit of the pain of tightening policy ahead of time,
subtitles.zh: 今年迄今收益率已上升约100个基点，正如我们所知，债券市场往往提前定价部分紧缩政策的压力，
en_highlights: risen the yield about 100 basis points
prices in a little bit of the pain

subtitles.en: so we feel pretty confident that we're on a bit of a path of recalibration of policy
subtitles.zh: 所以我们相当有信心，我们正处于政策重新校准的路径上

subtitles.en: that can help to tame the inflation picture we're looking at today. Ed, what did you think of Warsha's framing of the hike, tying it to the economy strengthening more than any kind
subtitles.zh: 这有助于遏制当前的通胀形势。Ed，你怎么看Warsha将加息与经济增长挂钩，而非担忧AI热潮或长期债券收益率飙升？

subtitles.en: of concern about the AI boom or the surge in lung bond yields? Yeah, I think that was the right way to position it. You know, the big change in the underlying story this year in the US has been
subtitles.zh: 我认为这是正确的定位。今年美国底层叙事的一大变化是

subtitles.en: the improvement in the labor market. We've been waiting for that improvement that kind of plates way through the economy. We finally got to a point where the upside risk that poses to inflation
subtitles.zh: 劳动力市场的改善。我们一直在等待这种改善渗透到整个经济中。我们终于到了这样一个点，即它对通胀构成的上行风险

subtitles.en: was impossible to ignore, and so we're starting to see that move. I think that's exactly the right framing.
subtitles.zh: 已不容忽视，所以我们开始看到这种变化。我认为这正是正确的框架。

clip_research.source_claim: The Fed's rate hike was framed as tied to the economy strengthening and labor market improvement, not to AI-boom concerns or surging long-bond yields, and the market has already priced in about 100 basis points of yield rise this year.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public Fed materials and Chinese financial media in the batch describe 2025 Fed actions mainly as rate cuts driven by labor market softening and inflation balance, with some coverage of a later hike under a new chair tied to inflation concerns.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip frames a hike as driven by labor market improvement and inflation upside risk, while the retrieved public baseline emphasizes 2025 cuts driven by labor market cooling; the two framings point in opposite directions and are not reconciled by the snippets.

evidence.fact: Speaker says the big change in the US story this year has been labor market improvement, and that the upside risk to inflation became impossible to ignore.
Speaker says the Bloomberg US aggregate yield has risen about 100 basis points already this year.

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
